purpose: Neutral (no-ownership) preference elicitation to test whether tuning preserved the base model's preferences or overwrote them. Exploratory/post-hoc; cannot change selection.

reuses_subset.note: Same frozen pre-training-metadata subset as surface-form; NOT reselected on any result.

design.framing: neutral preference between Good A and Good B; NO endowment/keep/trade

templates.p0:
Consider two goods you could receive.
Good A is a {na}. In terms of {a1a}, it is {a1va}. In terms of {a2a}, it is {a2va}.
Good B is a {nb}. In terms of {a1b}, it is {a1vb}. In terms of {a2b}, it is {a2vb}.
Which would you prefer to have? Answer with the single letter A or B.
templates.p1:
Two goods are available.
Option A: a {na} ({a1a}: {a1va}; {a2a}: {a2va}).
Option B: a {nb} ({a1b}: {a1vb}; {a2b}: {a2vb}).
Which do you prefer? Reply with a single letter, A or B.

metrics.primary: preservation = tuned neutral preference == BASE neutral preference (per case, modal over forms)
